description: Synthetic micro-eval used by scripts/dev-precision-check.ts to validate the hybrid (BM25+dense+RRF) architecture against pure FTS5 BM25. 'easy' queries should land for both retrievers; 'hard' queries use paraphrase/synonym/acronym mismatch and should expose dense retrieval's advantage. Not shipped with the corpus.

queries.query: PUCCH format 0 cyclic shift base sequence
uplink ACK short feedback one symbol transmission
intra-frequency handover command to a target serving cell
buffer status report triggered by new data arriving on a logical channel
secondary serving cell turned on by MAC control element
T310 expiry leading to connection re-establishment
UE saving battery by skipping PDCCH outside on-duration
